item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President announces an immediately effective amendment to an existing proclamation, but this introductory segment does not itself specify a substantive change in legal rights or duties.","evidence":"effective as of the date of this Proclamation"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The amendment gives the Secretary discretionary authority to permit excess imports after specified findings; it does not require a particular allocation or itself grant one.","evidence":"the Secretary may allocate imports"},{"segment_id":"3","code":2,"rationale":"Although much of the segment authorizes discretionary interim allocations, it also requires the Secretary to impose a specified later reduction on any subsequent allocation received by an interim-allocation recipient.","evidence":"shall be reduced by an amount equal to the interim allocation"}]}
